desc.ian_image_library:title: Ipomoea pes-caprae (Beach Morning Glory)
desc.ian_image_library:descr: In Hawaiian, this common flowering vine is called pohuehue. It was used by ancient Hawaiians for cordage, leaves as shade for fish traps, and medicinally.
